brief:
An Israeli drone strike hit al-Mawasi in southern Gaza, killing one person and wounding several others, according to the territory's Civil Defence, Middle East Eye reported. Al-Mawasi, a coastal area, has been designated a humanitarian zone during the ongoing conflict.

No additional details were immediately available about the circumstances of the strike or the identities of those killed and injured.
dek: Israeli drone strike kills one in Gaza’s al-Mawasi Gaza’s Civil Defence says an Israeli drone struck al-Mawasi in the south of the Strip, killing one person and wounding many others.
title: Israeli drone strike kills one in Gaza's al-Mawasi
